ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing ail of the B2-3,
Neighborhood Mixed-Use District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 22-G in
the area bound by:

South Halsted Street; West 95" Street; South Green Street; a line 88.5 feet north of and
parallel to West 95" Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Green Street; a
line 150 feet south of and parallel to West 94" Street,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
